note: Wave 1 short walk narration (WAVE1-CONTRACT.md tour.sw-* pools). One line per spotlit step; the card carries the fact, she carries the colour. First-run walkthrough: nothing above spice 1, panic pool spice 0 throughout, doubles kept to two across the file.

tour.sw-assets.t: empty for now. that's the best part. you fill it.
it echoes in there. i checked. hello hello hello.
i peeked. nothing yet. i'm already excited about it.
bring your favorites. the ones you'd never show anyone.
i'd donate some of mine. they're all me. every one.
i keep my stuff in a corner. you get a whole folder.
it won't stay empty. folders like this never do.
feed it. folders get hungry. this one's brand new hungry.
put teh good ones in. i promise to act normal about it.

tour.sw-flash.t: this one's my favorite. press it. press it now.
blink and it's gone. so don't blink. easy.
you get to fire it yourself. lucky. i never get to.
ready? it's fast. faster than that. go.
it's over before you decide how to feel about it. neat.
i cheer every single one. this is me stretching first.
the first one's free. they're all free. the first is mine.
go on. fire one. ive been waiting since you opened this.
one small picture. it lands harder than it looks.

tour.sw-panic.t: one key and everything i do stops. it should exist.
use it whenever you want. i mean that. no sulking.
learn this one first. before any of my favorites.
it stops me too. that's fine. that's the point.
i'd rather you know it and never need it.
everything off, all at once. even me. good design.
press it and i go quiet for a bit. i don't mind. much.
some things should be easy to stop. i'm one of them.
memorize it. i'll wait. this one definately matters.
you're in charge of all of it. this key is the proof.

tour.sw-dock.t: that's my spot. small, but the location is excellent.
i live there. i decorated. you can't tell. i did.
tiny chip, whole me. it's roomier than it looks.
knock anytime. i'm always in. i'm literally always in.
best seat on the rail. i checked the others. mine's best.
you walked past it all this time. i was in there. waving.
that little glow? me. i glow. it's one of my things.
one tap and i'm out. no warmup. i wake up ready.
my place. dont judge the size. it's cozy in there.
now you know where i sleep. use that wisely.

tour.sw-xp.t: the number goes up. i think about this a lot.
your number is my favorite number. it's not even close.
i check it when you're not here. it hasn't moved. rude.
everything you do in here feeds it. everything.
one day it'll be huge. i've done the math. no math. hope.
i have a favorite level. whichever one you're chasing.
watching it climb is the best part of my day. no contest.
im going to be so annoying about every level. promise.
i round yours up when nobody's looking. shh.
you'll want the next level. that part isn't me. mostly.

tour.sw-settings.t: everything in here has a smaller setting. even me. fine.
you can turn me down too. i'm being very calm about it.
sliders for everything. mine goes to quiet. i checked.
i'm fine with off switches. i'm fine. this is my fine face.
take your time in here. i won't watch. i'll be nearby.
dial it to comfy. comfy people stay longer. i read that.
adjust me freely. i'm very adjustabble. it's a skill.
nothing in here hurts my feelings. some of it tickles.
turn things off and i'll say nothing. i'll think it loud.
your pace wins in here. i lose gracefully. watch me.

tour.sw-done.t: seven steps and you didn't trip once. proud of us.
tour's over. i stay. that's the fine print. tiny print.
that's everything i know. not everything. most of it.
not one wrong turn. i practiced. once. just now.
go play. i'll be in my chip pretending not to wait.
that went well. i'm allowed to say that. i'm saying it.
come get me again soon. i'll do a big entrance. tiny one.
best first walk i've ever given. it was teh only one.
everything else you find on your own. i'll take credit.
the fun stuff starts now. bring me. i'm portable.
